written: 2026-11-15, before the sequential gate was implemented and before any result

sequential.call: sequential_mean_gate(iter(stream), support=SUPPORT, support_basis='synthetic generator support', alpha=0.05, budget=N)

fixed.call: strict_mean_gate(stream[:N], support=SUPPORT, support_basis='synthetic generator support', alpha=0.05, n_expected=N)

distributions: the twelve distributions of protocol.json (paper236-strict-gate-comparison 1.0): the same draw strings, means, supports and roles
seed_rule: seed = 20261116 + 10*dist_order.index(dist); rng = random.Random(seed); the 10,000 streams of 200 values are drawn in sequence, element by element. Every stream is fed to the sequential gate at every budget and its first N values to the fixed gate at every budget.

Q03_stops_before_unread_tail.stream: 8 x 1.0, then an item whose read raises

criteria.S1_validity: In every bounded null cell (unif0, skew0, skewc0, rademacher, skew_mild; every budget), the sequential gate's CONFIRMED count k of 10,000 has a Wilson 95% lower bound <= 0.05. A violation in any cell means the sequential gate is reported as invalid.
criteria.S2_gaussian_null: In every gauss0 cell, the same, counting INVALID_INPUT as not confirmed; INVALID_INPUT reported separately.
criteria.S3_capacity: No run is CONFIRMED with n_read <= 7 (all supports here are symmetric).
criteria.S4_dominance: For every stream and budget, a CONFIRMED fixed gate implies a CONFIRMED sequential gate; and every sequential confirmation at t equals a CONFIRMED fixed gate on the first t values (n_expected = t).
criteria.S5_evalue: At every stop with valid values (CONFIRMED at t, or NOT_CONFIRMED at N), the sequential e-value equals the fixed gate's e-value on the same prefix (relative difference <= 1e-12).
criteria.S6_edge_cases: Every edge case returns its expected status and n_read; ValueError for budget 0, budget True and alpha 0.
criteria.power_reporting: Descriptive. The paper may say the sequential gate has power in a cell only where the Wilson 95% lower bound of its confirmation rate is >= 0.5.
criteria.cost_reporting: Per cell: mean instances read (all runs), and the median and 90th percentile of the stopping index among confirmations; the fixed gate's confirmation rate at n = N on the same streams alongside.

run_rule: One run of the whole protocol. No change to c, the threshold, the supports, the distributions, the budgets, the streams or their number after results are seen. A bug fix after results goes into 'amendments' and every cell is rerun.
